seo.title: Fumeri Perfume | Shop at Swansura UK
seo.description: Fumeri perfume is about bold, long-lasting eaux de parfum at accessible prices, from amber nights to fresh blues. 100% authentic, free UK delivery over £40.

sc.value:
Fumeri perfume is about bold, long-lasting eaux de parfum at accessible prices, from amber nights to fresh blues. We stock 18 Fumeri scents, all in 100ml bottles, from £23.95 to £40.99. It is an easy brand to explore if you like a strong trail without a designer price tag.

Warm, smoky and amber

Fumeri Ambre Night wraps rich amber in dark woods and subtle spice. Smokey Leather opens with warm spice before a leather heart, and Oud Saffron For Men layers saffron over smoky depth. Fumeri 540 contrasts luminous saffron and jasmine, while Elixir and Wild bring spice and smoky woods. See more in our amber fragrances.

Fresh and clean

Blue For Men and Victorious For Men both lead with bright citrus and smooth woods, and Victorious adds marine accords. Fumeri Style 33 balances crisp citrus and aromatic notes with warmth, and Gris is a quieter, minimal scent of citrus, soft spice and smooth woods.

Floral and sweet

For a softer side, Rose Vetiver For Women sets rose petals against smoky vetiver, and Orchid Noir pairs velvety orchid with creamy woods. Angel For Women is gourmand, with vanilla and patchouli. Flirt opens with pink grapefruit and ripe peach before peony and jasmine, and Gabriella starts with mandarin and pink pepper. Peach, Adore and Orpheon complete the floral choices.

Most of the range is unisex, so it suits anyone. Browse more unisex perfume or compare with the extraits from SAP. Every Fumeri perfume we sell is 100% authentic and ships from the UK, and orders over £40 come with free UK delivery.

seo.title: Signature D'orient Perfume | Shop at Swansura UK
seo.description: Signature D'orient perfume is Arabian-inspired, and many of its eaux de parfum come with a 15ml travel spray for your bag.

sc.value:
Signature D'orient perfume is Arabian-inspired, and many of its eaux de parfum come with a 15ml travel spray for your bag. We stock 16 pieces, from £35.99 to £66.99. The style runs from clean musk and fresh citrus to warm amber and sandalwood.

Sets with a travel spray

Most of the range pairs a 100ml bottle with a 15ml spray. Musk, Onyx and Sapphire (£63.99 each) include a funnel so you can refill. Musk is a soft, clean musk perfume, Onyx is smoky with amber depth, and Sapphire is bright and citrus. Santal and Ambre (£63.99) are built on creamy sandalwood and rich amber. Aura, Paradiso and Charm (£63.99 to £66.99) come with a refillable travel spray, and Charm opens with fig and jasmine. Diamond is £65.99, Jade £66.99, and Opal and Rose £63.99.

Single bottles

Le Femme Gold 100ml EDP Spray (£35.99) is a radiant feminine scent with fruity notes and white florals. Black Pour Homme 100ml (£37.99) is a warm, woody men's fragrance with citrus and spice, and Blue 100ml (£38.99) is fresh and aquatic. These are good value if you only need one bottle at home.

Try before you choose

The Signature Discovery Set 10x10ml (£65.99) holds ten scents, fresh to rich. It is the easiest way into Signature D'orient perfume. Compare it with other Arabian perfume, browse Al Haramain, or see more perfume gift sets. Every bottle is 100% authentic and ships from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.

seo.title: Korloff Perfumes UK | Parisian Fragrances | Swansura
seo.description: Shop Korloff perfumes at Swansura UK. Discover Royal Rose, Royal Oud, Miss Korloff and more Parisian fragrances. Free UK delivery on orders over £40.

sc.value:
Korloff perfume brings Parisian elegance to nine bottles and sets at Swansura, from £19.99 to £82.99. The range moves from bright fruity florals to rose, oud and leather. Most bottles are 88ml or 100ml, so they last well, and every scent is listed as unisex.

Floral and romantic

Korloff Un Soir à Paris Eau de Parfum 100ml (£25.99) captures a soft evening in Paris, opening with bergamot and grapefruit. Korloff Royal Rose 88ml (£47.99) contrasts sparkling bergamot, mandarin and pink pepper with smoky depth. Miss Korloff 88ml (£35.99) is a fruity floral with apple, mandarin, cassis and ylang-ylang, and Lady Intense 88ml (£35.99) balances pear and orange with creamy florals.

Warmer and darker

Korloff In Love Eau de Parfum 100ml (£26.99) pairs rose and jasmine with oud, patchouli and tonka. Royal Oud 88ml (£47.99) opens with rose, incense and warm spice for a classic Middle Eastern style. Korloff Cuir Mythique Eau de Parfum 100ml (£82.99) explores leather through a smoky, modern lens. For a cleaner choice, Korloff In White Eau de Toilette 88ml (£32.99) is citrus and aromatic, made with the modern man in mind.

To sample before choosing, the Paris Discovery Set 3x10ml (£19.99) holds three scents from the house's feminine range. Browse more perfume gift sets, floral fragrances or oud fragrances. Every Korloff perfume is 100% authentic and ships from the UK, with free UK delivery on orders over £40.

seo.title: Trussardi Perfume | Shop at Swansura UK
seo.description: Trussardi perfume from the Italian fashion house covers elegant florals for her and one bold scent for him. 100% authentic, free UK delivery over £40.

sc.value:
Trussardi perfume from the Italian fashion house covers elegant florals for her and one bold scent for him. We stock six Trussardi pieces, from 7ml miniatures at £14.99 to the 90ml Pure Jasmine at £42.99.

Pure Jasmine

Trussardi Pure Jasmine opens with bergamot, pistachio and neroli, then settles into a rich heart of jasmine and champaca over vanilla, sandalwood and patchouli. You can choose the 90ml Eau de Parfum, the 7ml miniature or the Pure Jasmine Lifestyle Mini Gift Set at £29.99. The miniature is a simple way to get to know the scent first.

Delicate Rose and Ruby Red

Trussardi Delicate Rose Eau de Toilette is fresh and feminine, with kumquat and yuzu at the top, rose, lotus and jasmine at the heart and musk, cedarwood and sandalwood beneath. The Ruby Red Eau de Parfum Gift Set pairs a 60ml Ruby Red, with fruity florals, amber, vanilla and woods, with a 125ml Stardust Body Emulsion for £29.99.

For him

Black Extreme Eau de Toilette 7ml Miniature is bold and masculine. Lemon and marine notes lead to plum and violet leaf, finishing with leather, patchouli and vetiver. The 7ml size slips easily into a jacket pocket or gym bag.

The minis are easy to carry and make good stocking fillers, and both sets sit in our perfume gift sets edit. For more jasmine and rose, see floral fragrances. Every Trussardi perfume we sell is 100% authentic and ships from the UK.
